policies.Shando: Two actual choice-only faces, printed order deck-buff then friendly current-Beast transform; combine only through existing choose-both rule. Deck buffs capture each original own current Beast/all minion physical card. Transform uses original source residence and current target material, without a new battlecry.
policies.Head: Own turn start, at least three ordinary active friendly current Mech/all minions. Capture all eligible physical minions including Head, destroy in one native batch, then source-attributed original-position ordinary summon of actual V-07-TR-0N; death reactions, capacity and summon quantities remain native.
policies.Token: Full fixed client face plus complete bilingual primary API face. Charge and four-attacks Mega-Windfury are explicit keywords taken from printed text, not inferred from a missing raw mega flag.
policies.Talritha: One equal physical weight per original own hand current Dragon/all minion. Ordinary plus3/plus3 then permanent original-hand-reference plain Deathrattle grant via original attachment installer. Inherited body uses the actual new death actor and recurses normally; no dummy CAST or fake spell.
policies.Rotgill: Capture all other ordinary active friendly minion residences; ordinary Deathrattle grants. Each actual granted death buffs the current friendly active group plus1/plus1 through original attribute layer.
policies.Invincible: Printed Reborn. Both actual Battlecry and Deathrattle choose one other current friendly active Undead/all minion for ordinary plus5/plus5 and Taunt; original Reborn produces a fresh base face at one health without an extra battlecry.
policies.StoredGrant: Append nullable stored_card to original GrantDeathrattle, preserving its five original fields. Only a permanent plain body on exact original HAND minion CardReference, source required; stale residence skips, invalid printed kind errors. Reuse original attachments, lifecycle, copy and serializer; private owner event does not reveal hand material to opponent.

uncertainties: Two actual Shando choice faces are complete fixed-client records; primary API lookups returned full unavailable responses retained in evidence. No primary verification claim is made for these two faces.

Shando copy branch uses existing IF_AVAILABLE semantics, including no eligible Beast or source-self target behavior. Combined order is deck buff then current target transform. Precise official targeting/timing remains deferred.

Head destroys all active ordinary friendly current Mechs including itself, excluding dormant minions, then summons at captured Head position through normal capacity and death reactions. Exact official dormant/position/death-window details use this explicit local policy.

Talritha uses equal weight per physical original current hand Dragon/all minion; a stale original hand reference after the buff reaction skips the subsequent grant. The grant is owner-private even if the physical card was previously revealed.

Rotgill grants only the original other active friendly group; later death buffs current active friends under actual death actor control. Invincible uses ordinary current Undead/all eligibility and Reborn ordering. Precise official simultaneous-death/control windows remain deferred.

Enchantments and Talritha blank effect dummy remain evidence only, not standalone collectible cards or generation candidates. Actual choice faces are nonphysical, V-07-TR-0N is a physical token dependency.

The original twelve-root frontier and pending seven actual roots remain in scope; this five-root phase does not redefine the full source or goal. All remaining special pools, past source binding, eligibility and version/hotfix/CN alignment remain open.
